dimensions.assessment: Affects National Forest System units, ski area operators, local governments, and visitors utilizing national forest recreation sites.
dimensions.evidence: collected by the Department of Agriculture (USDA) from ski area operators on NFS land

dimensions.assessment: Allows forest units to retain 60% to 80% of collected rental fees for local projects such as facility repairs, wildfire mitigation, and visitor services.
dimensions.evidence: allows National Forest System units to keep the majority of ski area permit rental fees that were generated within their boundaries

dimensions.assessment: Directs ski area rental charges into a special Treasury account available for expenditure without further appropriation, supplementing existing appropriations.
dimensions.evidence: be available to the Secretary for use, without further appropriation

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Omnibus Parks and Public Lands Management Act of 1996 to establish a new retention account and rules for fee distribution.
dimensions.evidence: provide for the establishment of a Ski Area Fee Retention Account, and for other purposes

dimensions.assessment: Permanent change to how rental charges are handled, with deposited funds remaining available for 4 fiscal years.
dimensions.evidence: remain available for the period of 4 fiscal years beginning with the first fiscal year after the fiscal year

missing_information: Total annual dollar amounts collected from ski area permit rental charges.
importance_detail.rationale: Establishes a Ski Area Fee Retention Account allowing National Forest System units to retain and use the majority of ski area permit rental charges for local administration, maintenance, and wildfire mitigation.
